summary.overview: LocalDeepL is a Web UI/API-first OCR and translation pipeline with strong agent guidance (AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) and layered validation (ruff, mypy, pytest fast/slow split, pre-commit, CI matrix). This is a session-limited review: no session sources are configured, so task episodes, delivery evidence, and learning capture are unobserved. Project inspection found repairable gaps in environment bootstrapping, command surface, agent lifecycle guardrails, CI affected-check routing, and JavaScript validation coverage. Priority moves: (1) add agent lifecycle guardrails for high-risk edits, (2) create a copyable .env.example template, (3) add a unified command surface with a doctor target.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md provides a strong 163-line navigation entrypoint with pipeline diagrams, a 50-row Key Files table, extension points, and known tech debt. ARCHITECTURE.md adds a detailed directory-responsibility table and dated change blueprints. Guidance is Present but was not exercised in any observed task episode.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: uv sync and Docker compose provide repeatable setup, but no .env.example template, no unified command surface, no doctor command, and no agent lifecycle guardrails exist. Pre-commit is the sole local guardrail and is bypassable. The permission boundary for agent-produced changes is Missing.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: 43 test files, fast/slow marker split, ruff, mypy, and CI form a solid validation foundation. However, CI lacks affected-check routing, JavaScript browser assets have no lint or test coverage, and no failure-diagnosis or post-repair revalidation was observed in any task episode.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Three CI workflows and a version-driven release flow are Wired, but no current-revision delivery decision, high-risk approval, or rollback evidence was observed. GitHub branch protection and required status checks are not inspectable from the local filesystem and remain Unobserved.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: A bounded Learning Capture review was completed. Skills scan and Memory governance were clean, but session sources are not configured, so lifecycle demand, pattern detection, and routing remain unevaluable. No comparable observation windows exist to support longitudinal validation.

findings.title: Environment configuration has no copyable template
findings.reason: The .env file is gitignored but no .env.example or equivalent template exists in the repository. An agent must read scattered AGENTS.md prose to identify and assemble required environment variables (auth token, SSRF flag, LLM API base, circuit-breaker tunables) before the server can start. This blocks reproducible cold-start setup from repository files alone.
expectedOutput: A .env.example file with all configurable env vars, safe defaults, and inline comments.
Cold-start setup succeeds by copying the template without reading prose documentation.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Create a .env.example file at the project root listing all configurable environment variables with safe local-development defaults and inline comments. Keep the existing AGENTS.md documentation as the authoritative reference.

## Validation

- Verify the file lists every env var referenced in AGENTS.md Web Notes and compose.yaml
- Confirm `cp .env.example .env` produces a runnable local-development configuration

findings.title: No unified command surface for setup, run, and reset
findings.reason: Setup, run, lint, test, and reset commands are scattered as raw uv invocations across AGENTS.md Quick Start and Validation sections. No Makefile, Taskfile, or equivalent exists. No doctor or self-diagnosis command verifies runtime health (Python version, uv, Redis, model server availability). An agent must manually assemble multi-step operations and has no self-diagnosis route.
expectedOutput: A Makefile or Taskfile with intent-named targets for setup, run, test, lint, typecheck, clean, and doctor.
A doctor target that checks Python version, uv, Redis, and model server availability.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Add a single command surface (Makefile or Taskfile) with intent-named targets for setup, run, test, lint, typecheck, clean, and doctor. Keep the existing uv commands as the underlying implementation.

## Validation

- Run `make help` or `task --list` and confirm all targets are documented
- Run `make doctor` or `task doctor` and confirm it reports runtime health

findings.title: Agent-produced changes have no lifecycle guardrails
findings.reason: No Qoder hooks, permission allowlists, sandbox configuration, or Stop-gate evidence exists for agent-produced changes. Pre-commit is the sole local guardrail and is bypassable with --no-verify. High-risk edits to core modules, security files, or production paths receive no deterministic pre-action feedback or approval requirement.
expectedOutput: Agent lifecycle guardrails (hooks or permission rules) for high-risk edits.
A high-risk edit to a core module receives specific pre-action feedback or approval requirement.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Add the smallest set of agent lifecycle guardrails (hooks or permission rules) that give actionable feedback for high-risk agent actions such as editing core modules, pushing to main, or modifying security-sensitive files. Keep the existing pre-commit configuration.

## Validation

- Confirm the guardrail produces specific repair or approval guidance for a high-risk edit
- Verify the guardrail is not bypassable by default

findings.title: CI runs the full validation suite on every change without affected-check routing
findings.reason: The test.yml workflow has no path filters or changed-file logic. Every push to main and every PR triggers the full fast test suite, ruff, and mypy across a Python 3.11 and 3.13 matrix, increasing feedback latency for scoped changes. AGENTS.md documents focused-test commands locally, but CI does not scope validation to affected areas.
expectedOutput: Path filters or changed-file detection in test.yml that scopes CI validation to affected areas.
A scoped change triggers only the relevant validation steps.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Add path filters or changed-file detection to the test.yml workflow so CI scopes validation to affected areas. Keep the existing matrix, ruff, mypy, and pytest steps.

## Validation

- Confirm a change to only tests/ does not trigger mypy on src/
- Confirm a change to src/ still runs the full relevant validation

findings.title: JavaScript browser assets have no lint or test validation
findings.reason: The static/js/ directory contains 4 source files with 0 test files. No JS lint or test tooling is configured in pyproject.toml, pre-commit, or CI. The existing test_ui.py Playwright smoke test is not wired into CI. An agent editing browser UI code has no automated feedback loop for that surface.
expectedOutput: A JS lint step that validates static/js/ changes in pre-commit or CI.
test_ui.py Playwright smoke test wired into the nightly CI workflow.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-loop fix this issue

Add minimal JS lint validation (e.g., eslint or standardjs) to pre-commit or CI, and wire the existing test_ui.py Playwright smoke test into the nightly workflow. Keep the existing Python validation unchanged.

## Validation

- Confirm a JS lint step runs on static/js/ changes
- Confirm test_ui.py runs in nightly CI

findings.title: Session capture is not configured, preventing Learning Capture assessment
findings.reason: No session sources are configured for this workspace. The Skills scan and Memory governance scan were clean, but lifecycle demand, pattern detection, and routing remain unevaluable. Without session evidence, the harness cannot distinguish repeated work, confirmed maintenance drift, or reusable learning opportunities across task episodes.
expectedOutput: Session capture enabled for the workspace, or a documented decision to accept the session-limited boundary.
A subsequent Learning Capture review can evaluate lifecycle demand and pattern detection.
findings.aiFixPrompt:

Enable session capture for this workspace or document the session-limited evidence boundary as intentional. If enabling, verify session sources produce eligible candidates for at least one bounded task.

## Validation

- Run session-analysis facts and confirm at least one eligible session is found
- Confirm the Learning Capture review can distinguish clean, gap, or needs-more-evidence
